description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402] Says what is at an address using on-chain evidence: empty account, EIP-7702 delegated account, EIP-1167 minimal proxy, EIP-1967 proxy (with implementation and admin), Safe wallet (with owners and threshold), or other contract. Each classification lists the evidence. It is not a safety verdict.

address.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

block.description: "latest" (default), "safe", "finalized", or a decimal block number. Every value in the answer is read at this one block

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

name: evm_contract_type
title: Classify an EVM address
